node: Off-premise packaging, disposables, and delivery-enabling consumables
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the public-company universe for restaurant off-premise packaging. The strongest underfollowed pure-play candidate found is Karat Packaging, a small-cap manufacturer/distributor of disposable foodservice products used by restaurant chains and distributors. Graphic Packaging is a mid-cap paperboard and foodservice packaging supplier with QSR exposure but broader end-market dilution. Amcor is a large-cap reference name after absorbing Berry Global, giving it direct exposure to foodservice cups/lids and QSR packaging, though the restaurant node is not pure. Sysco is included only as a reference/context anchor because its distribution network can influence restaurant procurement of food and non-food supplies, but it is not a packaging manufacturer. Layer 1B expands the public-market universe for restaurant off-premise packaging. The clearest underfollowed public candidate is Karat Packaging, a small-cap focused on disposable foodservice products for restaurant chains and foodservice settings. Graphic Packaging is a mid-cap reference-to-underfollowed hybrid with explicit QSR exposure in cups, lids, and food containers. Amcor is now the public reference anchor after acquiring Berry Global, which had direct QSR, coffee-shop, and foodservice packaging exposure, but Amcor is less pure and larger-cap. Sonoco is included as a lower-confidence underfollowed hypothesis because it has foodservice/QSR-adjacent smallware, trays, and fiber packaging capabilities, but restaurant off-premise exposure appears less direct and needs segment/customer verification.
